name: Animals That Became Famous
description: A space dog, a cloned sheep, a loyal Akita and a circus elephant: individual animals whose lives made headlines and whose statues still stand.

checkpoints.name: Beasts of the age
checkpoints.note: A canal horse, a circus elephant and a faithful terrier become famous, helped by newspapers and showmen.

checkpoints.name: War heroes and screen stars
checkpoints.note: Dogs and birds serve in war, sled dogs race medicine to Nome and Rin Tin Tin and Seabiscuit are fans' favourites.

checkpoints.name: Space and science
checkpoints.note: Laika and Ham go into space, Secretariat wins the Triple Crown, and Dolly the sheep becomes the first mammal cloned from an adult cell.

checkpoints.name: Last of their kind
checkpoints.note: The deaths of Lonesome George and Koko draw wide attention to conservation and animal minds.
